Environment / key symptom: Calico 3.28/3.29; 3 nodes; VXLAN; DNS/TCP fail across nodes while ICMP works; maintainer noted missing VTEP information

Title: Image pull fails while unmounting temporary mount: device or resource busy
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause/fix unconfirmed
Environment / key symptom: MKE on RHEL 7.9; image pull cleanup fails with EBUSY during temporary mount unmount; closed not planned

Title: Containers repeatedly enter UNKNOWN state
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause unresolved
Environment / key symptom: containerd k8s.io namespace; tasks intermittently UNKNOWN with PID 0 or STOPPED; open in fetched snapshot

Title: Admission webhook call times out when applying Ingress
Evidence status: Source validated; precise cause unconfirmed
Environment / key symptom: API server HTTPS call to ingress-nginx admission webhook exceeds 30-second timeout; historical Ingress API

Title: Ingress reports no active Service endpoints when endpoints exist
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause unconfirmed
Environment / key symptom: ingress-nginx 1.6.4; Kubernetes 1.25.6 EKS; controller reports no active endpoints despite reporter reachability test

Title: Ingress controller fails because admission webhook certificate Secret is missing
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause needs comment review
Environment / key symptom: ingress-nginx 0.45; Kubernetes 1.21; ARMv7; controller startup fails because webhook-cert Secret is missing

Title: Cluster Autoscaler interaction with WaitForFirstConsumer volume binding
Evidence status: Source validated; outcome needs review
Environment / key symptom: Historical AWS multi-AZ setup; zone-specific node groups and delayed PV binding complicate scale-up simulation

Title: Cluster Autoscaler gets stuck fixing node group sizes
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause/fix unconfirmed
Environment / key symptom: Cluster Autoscaler 1.28; Kubernetes 1.25; AWS; repeated Failed to fix node group sizes while decreasing ASG

Title: Cluster Autoscaler scale-down causes workload downtime
Evidence status: Source validated; not a confirmed autoscaler defect
Environment / key symptom: EKS; Cluster Autoscaler 1.12.3; report describes downtime during scale-down; drain/PDB/eviction semantics need comment review

Title: Flannel requires br_netfilter module but requirement is not documented clearly
Evidence status: Source validated; requirement demonstrated
Environment / key symptom: Flannel 0.24.2/0.25.4; Kubernetes 1.30+; unloading br_netfilter breaks expected networking; Linux VM is preferred reproduction target

Title: CoreDNS service (kube-dns) unreachable from pods
Evidence status: Root cause confirmed; reproduced by reporter and fixed by CIDR correction
Environment / key symptom: Pods could query individual CoreDNS Pod IP but not Service ClusterIP; Pod CIDR overlapped Service CIDR; cluster recreated with non-overlapping ranges and DNS worked

Title: DaemonSet pod can be permanently stuck Pending when its target node is saturated by equal-priority pods during mass rescheduling
Evidence status: Candidate; not counted in 150
Environment / key symptom: Reporter provides deterministic reproduction claim; open and awaiting triage; no confirmed upstream fix yet; research candidate only

Title: User can easily crash an entire cluster by creating pod with memory-backed EmptyDir
Evidence status: Root cause and mitigation confirmed; safe reproduction requires isolation review
Environment / key symptom: Memory-backed emptyDir (tmpfs) without effective Pod memory limits can overcommit node memory; maintainers recommend memory limits and ResourceQuota enforcement; dangerous to reproduce without hard outer memory cap

Title: Empty cache files causes KillPodSandbox errors when deleting Pods
Evidence status: Source validated; fix lineage identified; release applicability requires verification
Environment / key symptom: Pod remains Terminating because sandbox CNI DEL fails while decoding cached CNI result; libcni fix identified in CNI PR 1072 and integrated in containerd PR 10106; some older releases reported recurrence

Title: ReplicaSet controller continuously creating Pods rejected by kubelet due to SysctlForbidden
Evidence status: Candidate for later ReplicaSet module; partial mitigation only
Environment / key symptom: Invalid/unsafe sysctl rejected by kubelet while ReplicaSet hot-loops creating replacement Pods; PR 130411 proposed cold-loop backoff but was not merged; do not count as resolved

Title: Some crashed or OOMKilled containers fail to restart in v1.35
Evidence status: Root cause confirmed; fix merged in PR 137146
Environment / key symptom: Kubernetes 1.35.0; after kubelet restart, regular container in Pod with restartable init sidecar and startupProbe is not restarted; PR 137146 merged 2026-03-19

Title: Warnings on missing pull secrets can be confusing
Evidence status: Root cause confirmed; fix merged in PR 138432
Environment / key symptom: Missing imagePullSecret generated repeated warnings even when image pull succeeded; PR 138432 merged 2026-06-26 to warn only when image pull fails

Title: Constant kube-system pod restart due to SandboxChanged under Ubuntu Jammy
Evidence status: Workaround reported by multiple users; exact universal root cause not confirmed
Environment / key symptom: Ubuntu 22.04; kubeadm; containerd; SandboxChanged loop; users report SystemdCgroup=true and matching pause image resolves their environment; historical stack

Title: Container init exited prematurely after OOMKilled
Evidence status: Reporter-confirmed configuration root cause; not a Kubernetes defect
Environment / key symptom: Kubernetes 1.14.6; reporter traced restart failure to erroneous ConfigMap key change and deleted mounted file; correcting ConfigMap and deleting Pod restored operation

Title: PLEG health failures cause node Ready/NotReady flapping
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause partial
Environment / key symptom: Historical K8s 1.6.2/CoreOS and later Ubuntu; operators reported runtime-version correlation involving runc/containerd; no universal cause

Title: HTTP probes time out while application responds quickly
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause unresolved
Environment / key symptom: High short-lived Pod churn; direct Pod-IP requests returned within 7ms while kubelet probes timed out; later reports on K8s 1.31; maintainer requested kubelet pprof

Title: Exec probes create significant CPU and system-load overhead
Evidence status: Source validated; partial mitigation evidence
Environment / key symptom: K8s 1.15.3 and later containerd reports; trivial exec probes scale CPU overhead with Pod count; runc 1.2 reduces some exec overhead but kubelet path remains discussed

Title: CPU limits cause unexpected CFS throttling
Evidence status: Source validated; kernel/workload diagnosis case-dependent
Environment / key symptom: Original reports linked CFS bandwidth accounting kernel bugs and fixes; follow-up #97445 documents later workload-dependent throttling and microbursts; do not treat all throttling as one defect

Title: Hung NFS volume operations can block kubelet Pod startup
Evidence status: Historical source validated; original reproduction no longer reliable
Environment / key symptom: NFS outage or stale file handle can wedge volume teardown and delay new Pod volume setup; maintainer said original repro no longer worked; later EFS reports involved storage deletion ordering

Title: CRI reports container RUNNING after its task has stopped
Evidence status: Source validated; unresolved stale issue with later recurrence
Environment / key symptom: containerd 1.7.27/K8s 1.31.2; ctr task STOPPED but crictl reports RUNNING and zero finishedAt; later 2026 K3s report under high-churn CronJobs

Title: Container creation timeout surfaces proc-zero namespace error
Evidence status: Research candidate; issue closed stale and proposed PR not merged
Environment / key symptom: Under high IOPS task-state lookup may time out and zero-value PID leads to lstat /proc/0/ns/ipc; PR 10566 described the path but was not merged

Title: Pod remains Terminating because containerd retains a zombie container
Evidence status: Original root cause confirmed; related kernel symptoms distinct
Environment / key symptom: Original containerd shim exit-processing race fixed by merged PR 10651 on 2024-09-05; io_uring and RCU reports were separate kernel bugs

Title: Pod deletion fails when CNI network namespace cannot be removed
Evidence status: Source validated; root cause environment-dependent
Environment / key symptom: containerd 1.2.9; CNI netns unlink fails with device or resource busy; comments discuss ip netns mount behavior, CSI mount propagation and fs.may_detach_mounts workaround

Title: Projected kube-root-ca volume fails because ConfigMap is not registered
Evidence status: Original regression root cause confirmed; later similar reports may be different bugs
Environment / key symptom: Original issue affected K8s 1.22.0-1.22.8 and 1.23.0-1.23.5; maintainer says fixed in 1.22.9+, 1.23.6+ and 1.24+; later same-message reports need fresh reproducers

Title: Failed first CNI ADD leaves Pod stuck in ContainerCreating
Evidence status: Source validated; underlying IPAM plugin behavior identified
Environment / key symptom: Multus and Whereabouts IP pool exhaustion; CNI maintainer points to failing DelegateDel because CNI DEL should be permissive; reporter said Whereabouts IPAM would be fixed

Title: Kubelet reports exit code 137 after container exited normally
Evidence status: Source validated; accepted issue with reproducible reports; root cause unresolved
Environment / key symptom: RestartPolicy Never Pods can show ContainerStatusUnknown or exit 137 despite runtime exit evidence; reproducer on GKE 1.31.6 and report on K8s 1.34.3; issue remains open

Title: CSI unmount retry loop floods kubelet logs when vol_data.json is missing
Evidence status: Candidate; not reproducible in upstream issue
Environment / key symptom: Kubelet repeatedly fails CSI unmount because vol_data.json is missing; reporter suspects stale actual-state cache; closed not-reproducible/rotten; restart kubelet reported as workaround

Title: High-concurrency Pod creation causes PVC mount timeouts
Evidence status: Candidate; historical closed/rotten issue with reproducer claim
Environment / key symptom: K8s 1.22.8/1.23.1; 10-node on-prem cluster; reporter claims 800 Pods sharing a PVC cause attach/mount timeouts; no confirmed root cause or fix
